review: Previous goal turn made source corrections, verified a full comparison and improved mappings; it was progress. This batch uses that checked current worktree and binary snapshot.

Scan full JSON plus lower-scoring short diffs; compare raw native instructions, callee identity and actual stack argument positions. The Mage annotations from earlier recovery were contradicted by these native operands and have been corrected.
Fallen Empires basic_upkeep has no ability-mode parameter, unlike generic_activated_ability. Its green argument is at esp+0x18; do not infer colors from the slot alone.

Hissing Iguanar and Magnetic Mine byte-derived counts stay nonnegative; jg versus jne loops do not require source changes. Card-table base-plus-field offsets compensate exactly. Kaya cmp 8/setge equals cmp 7/setg. Chrome Mox native DUH mode is specialized through duh_mode and is not a constant mandatory-mode correction.
Dialog control-token scan independently found the two missing automatic-choice options. Native readonly strings encode 01 0e; the fork does not label these short control strings as ordinary text.

No global enum renumbering, padded source, forced register allocation or synthetic stack-slot aliases are used. One combined build and focused compiled contract checks follow; the baseline full report becomes a historical snapshot after rebuilding.
The first build caught a duplicate replacement at one subtype site. Both distinct sites were corrected before the successful build; final source receipts describe the corrected two-site edit.

The compiled-value checker also caught an event-name assumption: 0x72 is EVENT_RESOLVE_ACTIVATION; EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE is 0x73. The final chooser source uses the native resolve event and no enum value is changed.
scope: Native caller operands and control-flow contracts for ten functions. Neither printed card rules nor a similarity score override the release instructions. Not a whole-game equivalence or complete recovery claim.
